findings.body: The share response contains the WhatsApp URL, but this endpoint awaits `bus.publish` before returning it. The recorder awaits the database insert, so a slow or stalled usage write delays the share action. The test covers a write that fails promptly, not a write that remains pending. Usage recording must be detached from delivery of the copy or share result.
findings.title: Not done: Recording a usage event never blocks the action
